metadata.description: Synthetic Demonstration Profiles for KaushalSetu AI Recommendation Engine Validation
metadata.disclaimer: These profiles are synthetic test cases engineered to probe edge cases, constraint boundaries, and responsible AI disclosures. They DO NOT represent real individual learners or real user outcomes.

profiles.test_scenario: Welding and fabrication learner with 10th pass and 4 years experience
profiles.expected_behavior: Should retrieve welding/fabricator qualifications (e.g. Stainless Steel Fabricator, Manual Metal Arc Welding). High text relevance and confirmed ELIGIBLE status on multi-clause pathways accepting 10th + 4 yrs.

profiles.test_scenario: CNC and precision machining learner with 10th pass and 2 years experience
profiles.expected_behavior: Should retrieve CNC operator, machinist, turner, and tool room qualifications with high domain alignment.

profiles.test_scenario: Electrical and instrumentation enthusiast with 10th pass and 1 year experience
profiles.expected_behavior: Should retrieve instrumentation and electrical technician courses, evaluating admission criteria transparently.

profiles.test_scenario: Learner with missing/null educational qualification but with work experience
profiles.expected_behavior: System must NEVER mark candidate as ELIGIBLE. Must evaluate all returned options as UNKNOWN with explicit notice that education is missing.

profiles.test_scenario: Learner exploring traditional craft qualifications with minimal schooling
profiles.expected_behavior: Should retrieve PM Vishwakarma craft qualifications (Lohar/Blacksmith, Locksmith, Armourer). Preserves open-entry or N.A. criteria without inventing barriers.

profiles.test_scenario: Learner with no formal schooling applying for advanced technical courses in strict mode
profiles.expected_behavior: When candidate fails mandatory entry criteria (e.g. requires 10th or 12th) and exclude_unknown_eligibility is true, ineligible courses are pruned, returning 0 unverified claims.

profiles.test_scenario: Learner with strict short duration (<=300h) and zero-fee budget (PMKVY free only)
profiles.expected_behavior: Excludes all long courses (>300h) and all courses with known non-zero fees. Retains only short free/subsidized courses.

profiles.test_scenario: Completely out-of-domain query with zero vocational catalogue terms
profiles.expected_behavior: System does NOT invent fake qualifications. Text relevance scores remain near zero (<=0.05). System returns honest limitations.
